# Belle Allure Aesthetics and Wellness

> Belle Allure Aesthetics and Wellness is a physician-owned medical practice in Elkhart, Indiana. Registered Nurse Katherine Clark provides aesthetic and wellness care under the oversight of a licensed medical doctor, with individualized treatment planning, patient education, and free consultations.

## Visit

- Address: 320 West Bristol Street, Elkhart, IN 46514
- Phone: 574-735-1528
- Hours: Monday to Wednesday 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM; Thursday 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM; Friday 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM; select Saturdays; Sunday closed; closed on all holidays
- All visits are by appointment. Book online at https://belleallurefacialaesthetics.myaestheticrecord.com/online-booking/book-appointment or call 574-735-1528.

## Provider

- Katherine Clark, RN: Registered Nurse with 20+ years of medical experience and Certified Aesthetic Nurse Injector credential
- Works under the oversight of a licensed medical doctor
- Offers free consultations to help clients choose a treatment plan that fits their goals

## Services

Each service has its own page, and all services are listed on the services page: https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services

- [Wrinkle treatments](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/wrinkles-treatment): softer lines that still look like you
- [Dermal fillers](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/fillers): fuller contours and a balanced look
- [PRF therapy](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/prf-therapy): platelet-rich fibrin, prepared from a small sample of the client's own blood
- [PRF facial microneedling](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/microneedling): starting at $350; smoother texture and a more even tone
- [PRF under eye repair](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/prf-under-eye-repair): starting at $250; refreshed skin beneath the eyes
- [TMJ therapy](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/tmj-therapy): support for a relaxed jaw and a comfortable day
- [Headache treatment](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/headache-treatment): relief from tension headaches
- [Hyperhidrosis treatment](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/hyperhidrosis-treatment): less sweating and more confidence
- [Hair restoration](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/hair-restoration): fuller-looking hair from the client's own platelets
- [IV therapy](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/iv-therapy): a boost that fits the client's week
- [Wellness injections and weight medications](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/weight-loss-treatment): steady support toward a weight goal
- [Acne medication](https://belleallureaestheticsandwellness.com/services/acne-medication): clearer skin with a plan built for the client

Final prices are confirmed during the consultation.

## Payment

- HSA cards are accepted for qualifying treatments when a provider prescribes them for a medical condition
- Call 574-735-1528 to ask about other payment options
